notes:
{製作|せいさく} refers to manufacturing or producing physical goods. It emphasizes the industrial or craftsman process of making things.

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{制作|せいさく}→制作：04320_seisaku⟧: production of creative/artistic works (films, art, music)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {製作|せいさく}: physical products (machines, furniture, goods)
- ⟦{制作|せいさく}→制作：04320_seisaku⟧: creative works (films, TV programs, artwork)

Note: In film credits, {製作|せいさく} often refers to the executive producer/financing side, while ⟦{制作|せいさく}→制作：04320_seisaku⟧ refers to the creative production side.
